note: USACE Rathbun Lake campground on a high prairie ridge between Buck Creek and Honey Creek, SW of Moravia; the last 2.5 miles in are gravel (200th Avenue). Woodland draws and timbered hillsides, a modern playground, and a boat ramp sheltered on three sides with a courtesy dock and fish-cleaning station. An 8-mile trail links to Honey Creek Resort. Unstaffed. --Claude
summary: Electric 50 and 54 sites confirmed; max_rig 90 and pull-through added; facilities confirmed; season (May-Sep) added; booking note (loop-move 14-day rule, booth hours) added; fees 25 -> 28. Waterfront lead: not waterfront -> lakeview; A-loop lakefront candidates unverified; split candidate (two camp areas ~2 km apart).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD not waterfront -> lakeview: the agency's own rec.gov site photos show the lake from A01, A05 and A09 (open water past the pad, through scattered trees), A24 (across the loop road), B22 (water just behind brush) and B25 (filtered through trees). A13, A17, A21, A26 and most B sites face prairie or woods. USACE also says 'the high ridge offers wonderful vistas of the lake'. 6 of 18 sampled photos show water.

POSSIBLE LAKEFRONT (not claimed, unsure, so downgraded to lakeview): the A loop's west row (A01, A03, A04, A05, A08, A09, A11, A12, plotted from the catalog's coordinates) sits outside the loop road, ~50-60 m from the imaged waterline. In between are a brushy bluff belt and an exposed sand shore (leaf-off imagery). A01's and A09's photos show grass and scattered trees down to the water, but the imagery shows a brush/tree band, so I can't confirm open land to the water. The B21-B24 tip sites are ~100 m from the bay, behind brush.

SPLIT CANDIDATE (criteria flag only): the 'two seperate camp areas' are ~1.9 km apart on separate roads. The A loop centres on ~40.8403,-92.8810 on the peninsula's lakeshore; the B area (B01-B28) lies around the stored pin. One rec.gov facility and booking page.

PIN OK for the B area: the stored 40.8578,-92.8888 is ~55 m from B01-B04. rec.gov's facility coordinate (40.8769,-92.8872) is ~2 km north in farmland and wrong. The A loop is the other area (see split).
FEES 25 -> 28: every Peak Season 2020-2028 on rec.gov lists STANDARD ELECTRIC $28, and every family site's price_range is 28. The stored 25 matches nothing there.
PHONE: stored phone is empty. rec.gov gives 641-724-3103 for May-September campground inquiries and 641-647-2464 (main office, closed season). apply.py does not write phone.
SITES: driveways 37-111 ft and equipment limits 45-90 ft; the shortest fit is B02 at 37 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits every site.
MILITARY: a rec.gov militaryDiscount rule value, if present, is not a discount claim; nothing written.
